serves_registry_rows: person.tie by distance band (an outer envelope for kin and acquaintance ties between areas; NOT by kind of tie)

sources.name: Social Connectedness Index, 2026 release (friendships as of 25 January 2026), European regions at NUTS 1, 2 and 3
sources.publisher: Meta, via the Humanitarian Data Exchange
sources.licence: the catalogue states 'Public Domain / No restrictions (CC0)'
sources.notice: Source: Meta, Social Connectedness Index (2026 release), via the Humanitarian Data Exchange; region boundaries, centre points and populations: Eurostat/GISCO. Shares are derived under a stated assumption and are not published by the source.

sources.name: NUTS 2024 boundaries (1:10 million), label points; population on 1 January 2024 by NUTS 3
sources.licence: Eurostat reuse policy; boundaries (c) EuroGeographics for the administrative boundaries

keys.origin: a German NUTS 3 area (400 of them), in population-weighted fifths of density
keys.destination: each European NUTS 3 area with a population and a shape (1,323)
keys.bands: own area; within 100 km; 100 to 300 km; farther in Germany; foreign Europe; beyond Europe is not identified

assumption: an area's users are taken as population^(1+g). g = 0 is 'in proportion to residents'. The index's own nested levels give g = 0.12 from one pair of levels and 0.04 from the other, which do not agree: the one-parameter form fails, and each share is given at g = 0 and at g = 0.12.
what_is_identified_without_the_assumptio: the distance exponent (about 1.0 between 100 and 400 km; 0.78 once same-Land and former-border terms are allowed)

verdict.kernel_predicts_own_area_ties: REFUSED in each density fifth: a law fitted on ties between areas misses the ties within an area by 0.18 to 0.44 of all ties. Being in the same area carries more than distance does.
verdict.share_within_1_km: NO LICENCE. The bracket printed spans 0.4 % to 48 % of own-area ties for the median area. Nobody measured it; do not use a value.
verdict.shares_by_band: readings under the stated assumption; no generator scored

limits: one undifferentiated count of friendship links: nothing by kind of tie, nothing about the household, nothing about messages
links among users active in 30 days with more than 20 friends; a stale tie counts as a daily one
foreign Europe assumes equal reach across countries and is the weakest band; ties beyond Europe are not in the file
privacy noise read from the file: about 2 % at NUTS 3
holds_no_real_feature: no area code, name or coordinate; rows by density fifth
